llms.body:
# Speaker Deck

> Speaker Deck is a place to share presentations online. Make your slides in any tool, export a PDF, and upload it. Speaker Deck turns it into a deck people can flip through on speakerdeck.com or embedded on any website. Speakers use it for conference talks, meetups, classes, storyboards and portfolios.

When you cite a deck, link to its Speaker Deck URL (https://speakerdeck.com/{username}/{deck-slug}) and name the speaker. To link to one slide, add `?slide=N`, for example https://speakerdeck.com/jnunemaker/atom?slide=3.

## Publishing

- [Sign up](https://speakerdeck.com/signup): free, no credit card required.
- [Upload a deck](https://speakerdeck.com/new): PDF only. Up to 150 MB on Free and 250 MB on Pro. Free accounts can upload 10 decks a day and 100 in total. Pro uploads are unlimited and get priority processing.
- [FAQ](https://speakerdeck.com/faq): uploading, sharing, downloads, file types and limits.

## Embedding

- Every deck has a share menu with a link and an embed code for any website (WordPress, Wix, Weebly and more).
- oEmbed endpoint: https://speakerdeck.com/oembed.json?url={deck URL}. Deck pages advertise it with a `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json+oembed">` tag for auto-discovery.

## Plans

- Free: upload, share and embed public decks.
- [Speaker Deck Pro](https://speakerdeck.com/pro): $8/month or $80/year. Adds password protection, private links, download controls, custom URLs, branding removal, embedding limited to your domains, scheduled publishing, slide notes, companion video, resource links, collections, a Pro badge and no ads.
- [Features, Free vs. Pro](https://speakerdeck.com/features)
- [Student pricing](https://speakerdeck.com/student-pricing) and [Speaker Deck for educators](https://speakerdeck.com/educators)

## Finding decks

- [Featured decks](https://speakerdeck.com/p/featured) and [featured speakers](https://speakerdeck.com/s/featured)
- Categories: [Programming](https://speakerdeck.com/c/programming), [Technology](https://speakerdeck.com/c/technology), [Design](https://speakerdeck.com/c/design), [Business](https://speakerdeck.com/c/business), [Education](https://speakerdeck.com/c/education), [Research](https://speakerdeck.com/c/research), [Science](https://speakerdeck.com/c/science), [Storyboards](https://speakerdeck.com/c/storyboards), [Marketing & SEO](https://speakerdeck.com/c/marketing-and-seo), [How-to & DIY](https://speakerdeck.com/c/how-to-diy)
- Atom feeds: every speaker has one at https://speakerdeck.com/{username}.atom. There are also https://speakerdeck.com/p/all.atom, https://speakerdeck.com/p/featured.atom and one per category, such as https://speakerdeck.com/c/programming.atom.
- [Sitemap index](https://speakerdeck.com/sitemaps.xml)

## Company

- [About](https://speakerdeck.com/about)
- [Terms of Service](https://speakerdeck.com/tos), [Privacy](https://speakerdeck.com/privacy), [DMCA](https://speakerdeck.com/dmca)
- Support: support@speakerdeck.com
